title: Who's Home

cards.text: Never ask your smart speaker who's home.
I live alone, and every night it answers, "Two people."
I reset it twice. Now it adds, "One is under the bed."
I didn't look. I slept on the couch, facing the bedroom door.
At 3am, the bed creaked, like someone climbing out from under it.
Then, from the bedroom, my own voice asked, "Who's home?"
On the shelf beside me, the speaker's blue ring lit up.

outro: Follow for a new story every night.
